label: Dell XPS 13 9345 13.4-inch laptop
description: 13.4-inch Snapdragon X Elite / X Plus Copilot+ laptop. Wireless is Qualcomm FastConnect 7800 DBS onboard: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz, up to 5760 Mbps, with Bluetooth 5.4. There is no Ethernet: Dell's port table lists only two USB4 40 Gbps USB Type-C ports with DisplayPort and Power Delivery, audio and video through those same USB-C ports, and no media-card reader or security slot. Ports: 2x USB4 Type-C only - no RJ45, no HDMI, no card reader.
notes: Zero wired NIC: wired means a USB-C dock or dongle, exactly like the 9340 already in the catalogue, but this chassis is the Snapdragon one, so its radio is Wi-Fi 7 rather than the 9340's Wi-Fi 6E. Dell's external ports table is the authority for the missing RJ45; the wireless module table is the authority for Wi-Fi 7.
